title: C Function
text: Integrate and call external C/C++ code from a Simulink model, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Sample period; {Configure custom code settings} sets the option to specify custom code location, {Port and Parameter Symbols} sets the symbols and symbol, {Block specified custom code supports multiple instances} sets the option to specify the same custom code locally in multiple C Function, {Output}, {Start} sets the initialization code no default, {Initialize Conditions} sets the reinitialization code no default, {Terminate} sets the termination code no default, {Headers} sets the locally specify header files for custom code no, {Sources} sets the locally specify source files for the custom code no, {Libraries} sets the locally specify a list of static or shared libraries no, {Search Directories} sets the locally specify directories containing header and source files for custom code no, {Defines} sets the locally specify preprocessor macro definition to be added to the compiler command line no, {Compiler Flags} sets the locally specify additional flags to be added to the compiler command line no, {Linker Flags} sets the locally specify additional flags to be added to the linker command line no, {Use same code as simulation} sets the option to use same or different codes for simulation and code and {Generate code as - is (optimizations off)} sets the option to allow parsing for code generation. Values come from the instance.
